title: The Baby Quilt That Needed Folding
youtube_title: The Baby Quilt That Needed Folding | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a baby quilt sliding off the line is awkward for one person. Greta notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
